Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -50.66% and leveraged; its default stop at 200 needs review. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is new and already down -44.49%. CRWD is up 5.25% and marked TRIM, offering a chance to take some profit. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding AI sector growth and how the conflicting signals from Bitcoin and Gold resolve for overall market direction.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and be cautious with new tech exposure given AI growth concerns.
plays: Adjust SOXL's stop from 200, given its -50.66% loss and leveraged decay. Protect capital.
Consider trimming CRWD, up 5.25% and marked TRIM, to lock in some profit.
